isolated_copy_experiment.meaning: DELETE turns pages into reusable free pages; the file only shrinks with VACUUM, which is not run on the live file

scenario_assumptions.basis: observed 4k-31k rows/hour in collected hours; low/mid/high cover 6k-25k rows/hour averaged over 24 h
scenario_assumptions.backups: 7 daily gzip copies at the measured 6.6x ratio

assumed_not_measured.server_side_build_temp_gib: 0 if images are loaded; about 4-6 if built on the server

conclusion: With session-quote retention (14-30 days) the projected total is about 16-30 GiB across the low/mid/high scenarios, leaving margin on a 70 GiB disk. Without retention the mid scenario reaches about 56 GiB and the high scenario about 98 GiB by day 180. These are scenario estimates under stated assumptions, not observations; re-measure after one full uninterrupted trading week.
